entries.title: Merge works on older GitHub Enterprise servers
entries.body: Pressing Merge on a merge card for a project on an older GitHub Enterprise server now squash merges the pull request. Before, the server turned the merge down and the card showed only "Bad Request". When GitHub turns a request down that way, the app now also shows the reason GitHub gave.
entries.noPicture: This changes how the app asks GitHub to merge, not how the merge card looks.
